children: Overview
France-based communication and data marketing firm's H1 revenue rose 3.9% yr/yr to €121.9 mln
Net revenue up 2.2%, driven by digital marketing and international growth
Magazine and insurance segments declined, offset by digital and international expansion
Outlook
Dekuple continues to execute Ambition 2030 plan, focusing on digital and international expansion
Company to pursue investments in technology and targeted acquisitions to strengthen European leadership
Strategic review of insurance business ongoing to determine long-term development options
Result Drivers
DIGITAL MARKETING MOMENTUM - Net revenue growth was mainly driven by digital marketing, which rose 8.4% yr/yr
INTERNATIONAL EXPANSION - International net revenue grew 37.1% yr/yr, reflecting organic growth and recent acquisitions
AI INTEGRATION - Co said integration and use of artificial intelligence across its value chain enabled acceleration in business performance
